title: Albany invented THIS??? - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris ,
7 hours ago
When nature calls, you answer. Going to the bathroom is a natural part of life, but it hasn’t always been as easy as it is today.
Credit: Canva With outhouses stuck outside, and basic holes in the ground not doing the trick, inventors worked for years to refine the experience, bringing toilets, sinks, and other ammenities to our restrooms. One of the most important parts of that experience originated right here in Albany, NY.
The Early Days of T.P While Toilets and Toilet Paper had been used since the late 16th century, their use did not become commonplace until the late 19th century, with the boom of the industrial revolution. The earliest commercial toilet paper was developed by a man named Joseph Gayetty, who sold individual sheets soaked in aloe. These did not sell well, and eventually, they ceased being made.
Credit: Canva Next up, came the Scott brothers (Edward, Clarence & Thomas). The three are allegedly also from Upstate New York, hailing from Saratoga County . However, they too, failed in their endeavor.
Why is New York Asking Residents to Eat Squirrel?
Download the WGNA Mobile App Now Seth Wheeler This all changed when Seth Wheeler, of Albany, NY stepped onto the scene. Seth was originally from Columbia County, but moved to the Capital in 1849 when his father’s company moved there.
Credit: Canva In 1871, he successfully filed a patent for a machine that manufactured perforated toilet paper , which allowed for rolls to be created, and individual pieces torn off. While it took some time for the invention to kick off, it certainly did in fair time. Now, it’s one of the most widely used products in the world, with hundreds of manufacturers all using the foundation that an Albany man built.
14 Celebs You Might Spot Anytime in Saratoga Springs, New York Gallery Credit: Brian Cody TSM Albany Getty Images Rachael Ray Born in Glens Falls, the former Food Network star and celebrity cook still calls Upstate NY home as Ray has a beautiful house in Lake Luzerne Getty Images David Hyde Pierce Pierce, who starred as psychiatrist Dr. Niles Crane on the NBC sitcom Frasier from 1993 to 2004, was born in Saratoga Springs and still calls it home Getty Images Former Train drummer Scott Underwood. The former drummer of the band Train was born and raised in Saratoga Springs and is frequently spotted in his hometown! Getty Images Shaun White Two-time Olympic gold medalist Shaun White - pictured here with girlfriend Nina Dobrev - has been spotted many times at the race track and around town. He - like the rest of us - loves himself some Hattie's Fried Chicken Getty Images Chris Stapleton It's a bit of a stretch, but anytime an artist plays at SPAC during track season there's always a chance they'll pop over the race course if they have some time. Stapleton is performing on Friday, August 26th, and with the Travers running the following day, who knows! Getty Images Bobby Flay His new home overlooks the Oklahoma Track at the Saratoga Race Course - one of the many celebs who grew to love the Spa City enough to make it their home. Getty Images Kevin Dillon - Entourage Actor Kevin Dillon, who played Johnny “Drama” Chase on HBO’s hit, Entourage , was a Siro's Restuarant investor a few years ago and still enjoys the race course with his buddies Getty Images Mike Francesa New York Sports Talk legend Mike Francesa (pictured here with Adam Sandler and Judd Hirsch) LOVES the Saratoga Racetrack, and even at the height of his popularity would take weeks off the radio show to enjoy Toga! Getty Images Piers Morgan Sometimes controversial television personality Piers Morgan was recently spotted after an overnight stay at the Adelphi Hotel in Saratoga Springs and commented on his Instagram page about how much he enjoyed his stay here. Will he be back? Getty Images Bill Parcells The Hall of Fame former head coach of the Giants, Jets, and Cowboys, Bill Parcells loves Toga so much he had a house here for many years - practically within walking distance to the race course. Getty Images The Dubai Crown Prince, Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum has been the Crown Prince of Dubai since 2008 and over the years, he's invested 10's of millions of dollars into the Saratoga economy. A horse racing enthusiast and horse owner, The Prince has been known to fly into town to catch one of his thoroughbreds in action! Photo: Getty Images Jimmy Fallon The talented SNL star and current host of the Tonight Show is a St. Rose grad and always pops up in various spots around Upstate New York. A celebrity who loves to be in front of large crowds, Fallon would eat up on Travers weekend Photo: Michael Borgos William Shatner William Shatner, the venerable Captain James T. Kirk from the legendary Star Trek series was in Upstate NY a few weekends ago for an annual Star Trek Convention in Ft. Ticonderoga. While he was in town, he enjoyed a trip around Lake George on a friend's boat
Getty Images Dave Portnoy and Miss Peaches Barstool Sports Founder Dave Portnoy (pictured here with the Famous Miss Peaches) doesn't only come Upstate to taste the pizza. His love affair with Saratoga Springs began when he was a little kid, and he would regularly visit the racetrack with his family. Now, in the summer months, he's a fixture around here. The 8 Nostalgic Drive-Ins of Upstate New York Here's a breakdown of the 8 Capital Region Drive-In Movie Theatres and their scheduled movies, weather permitting, for the Spring and Summer of 2025 Gallery Credit: Brian Cody TSM Albany Google Maps The Hollywood Drive-In, Averill Park NY A hop, skip, and jump away from Albany, the family-run Hollywood Drive-In is one of the area's largest. It usually opens in mid-April, and the 400-car theater, built in 1952, shows double features all week and hides prizes in popcorn boxes! Google Maps Jericho Drive-In, Glenmont NY This classic Capital Region mainstay, located at 21 Jericho Rd, Glenmont, usually starts showing movies around the third weekend of April.
Built in the mid-1950s, you know summer has officially arrived when you plan a trip to the Jericho Drive-In! Google Maps The Ozoner 29 Drive-in, Broadalbin NY Fulton County's Only Drive-In Theatre opens in mid-April! The Ozoner was built from the ground up and opened in August of 2003 and has a combined capacity for up to 500 cars, Google Maps Hi-Way Drive-In Movie Theatre, Coxsackie NY Known as the "Cinema under the Stars," this classic Drive-In between Catskill and Coxsackie is in Greene County, New York, and opens up in April.
The Hi-Way Drive-In Theatre has four screens and shows double features on each screen during the summertime. It's been in business since 1951. Google Maps Malta Drive-In Movie Theatre, Malta NY This Drive-in destination has been a Capital Region fixture since 1949 and features two screens and a concession stand. They usually start showing films in mid-April.
Located at 2785 State Route 9 in Malta, the theatre is easily identified by its large, flashing marquee. Google Maps The Glen Drive-In, Queensbury NY The Glen Drive-In is described as an old-time spot for double features under the stars on 2 digital projection screens.
The Glen Drive-In Theater started showing great movies in 1958!
They usually open up the first weekend in May. Google Maps Hathaway's Twin Drive-In Theatre, North Hoosick NY The drive-in movie theater in North Hoosick, New York, will open at the end of April.
Hathaway's Drive-In opened on May 7, 1948, with John Wayne in “Tall in the Saddle” Google Maps El Rancho Drive-In, Palatine Bridge NY Montgomery County's only Drive-In and Movie Theatre announced that, weather permitting, they'll be open in the middle of April.
Built in 1951 and officially opened in 1952, El Rancho Drive-in Theatre is a well-kept American classic. Everyone has their go-to spot and you can make the argument that they are all deserving of the title of the area's BEST Cider Donut. To determine the best of the best we once again went to our listeners to determine which ones to try So who serves the best cider donuts in the Capital Region? Smith's Orchard and Bake Shop Facebook Page 4. Indian Ladder Farms - Altamont Indian Ladder Farms Facebook Page Indian Ladder's cider donuts paired with one of their tasty hard ciders is a thing of beauty and the perfect paring! Lakeside Farms Facebook Page 2. Lakeside Farms Cider Mill - Ballston Lake Lakeside Farms Facebook Page A Saratoga County legend because of their great cider donuts as well as visits ever fall from the Cider Witch! Google Maps Streetview 1. Golden Harvest Farms - Valatie Golden Harvest Farms Facebook Page Year after year, Golden Harvest in Valatie simply runs away with the top spot in this poll. They are the NY Yankees of cider donuts: a perennial favorite and a local legend when it comes to delicious, freshly cooked cider donuts. Congrats to the Capital Region cider donut champ of 2023!
